title: Preserve legacy Chinese empty target language and empty titles in full backups
summary: Allow existing Chinese recordings/settings with an empty targetLanguage and existing empty recording titles to back up and restore without weakening English target or type validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Chinese recordings and settings with targetLanguage empty serialize and restore through an isolated real IndexedDB test.
Restoration preserves empty targetLanguage and all existing data.
Empty recording titles allowed by the existing editor remain empty after backup and real IndexedDB restore; non-string titles remain invalid.
English mode empty targetLanguage and non-string targetLanguage remain invalid.
npm run check, npm run build and notes/backup regressions pass.
evidence: Coordination doctor healthy; npm run check and npm run build passed; checkpoint COURSE-002 passed.
node tests/notes/rules-smoke.mjs passed, including Chinese empty targetLanguage, empty recording title, exact binary Blob round-trip, English target validation and invalid-type rejection.
Isolated real IndexedDB regression page extended to 36 checks at tests/storage/backup-smoke.html; browser verification awaited before publication.
